title: Is the “Death of Copper” Finally Here? Pat Gelsinger Sees a CPO Boom in 2028 for Two Reasons
text:

The “Death of Copper” is coming. And Pat Gelsinger believes 2028 could be the turning point.

Twenty years after predicting the end of copper interconnects, the former Intel CEO says two powerful forces are finally pushing co-packaged optics (CPO) toward mainstream adoption: a maturing silicon photonics supply chain and the explosive demands of AI infrastructure.

But the story goes far beyond CPO.

In an exclusive interview, Gelsinger reveals how Silicon Valley’s “Hardware Renaissance” is unleashing a new wave of deep-tech innovation—from startups challenging Nvidia’s interconnect architecture to companies developing potentially revolutionary AI memory.

Could this be the biggest transformation in semiconductor hardware in decades?
